title: The Fourth, 2026
logline: White fireworks over the dock, private, twenty-nine years white. The family, the ramp, the two chairs, the pup barking at the sky. At the page's bottom edge: a knee and a hand, and this year, beside the hand, a second hand on the step.

panels.composition: The dock from the shack steps under white fireworks: Gully pouring, Maria in the lawn chair, the daughter sixteen and the boy thirteen at the dock's end, the ramp, the pup barking at the sky. At the page's bottom edge, a knee in worn jeans with a hand on it, and beside it on the step a second hand, a woman's, resting on the wood. Nothing more of either.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a dock at night under white fireworks seen from shack steps with a heavy man pouring coffee, a woman in a lawn chair, two teenagers at the dock's end, a plank ramp, a small three-legged dog barking at the sky, and at the bottom edge a man's knee with a hand on it beside a woman's hand resting on the step, no words
image.notes: A second hand on the step. Reserved beyond that. Still white.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Twenty-nine years white. A second hand on the step.
